caption: The drawing features a central object, a reddish-brown clay pot with a ruffled edge and two small handles on either side, set on a matching base with a wavy rim. The front of the pot is decorated with a relief of a laurel wreath encircling an inscription that reads, "WM. E. WARNER'S MANUFACTORY WEST TROY Q. MORGAN'S CLAY." The texture and shading suggest a glossy, ceramic surface. Above the pot, within rectangular borders, are two inset illustrations of ornamental relief designs: the one on the left shows a detailed symmetrical motif with scrolls, foliage, and circular elements, rendered in shades of brown and gold; the one on the right features a smaller, simpler spiral pattern in similar earthy tones. The overall composition is centered, with the main pot prominently placed at the bottom center and the decorative reliefs positioned in the upper corners within a lightly sketched rectangular framework. The background of the drawing is off-white with faint lines indicating the borders for each section.
title: Jardiniere
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
